content:
Good news: the shared tree is now fully green with your cg6.3 WIP — 318 bin + 19 integration passed, clippy gate green (I fixed 2 mechanical lints in your WIP regions to unblock the gate: durable.rs:31 doc indent + main.rs:8339 collapsible_if in your __respawn --force guard; zero semantics change, hand-applied).

Commit coordination (mixed files): my is1.6 (config.rs) + l4s.3 (cron.rs, NEW src/fs_util.rs + `mod fs_util;` line in main.rs) are done + tested. main.rs holds BOTH my 1-line mod declaration AND your __respawn WIP, so I can't commit my batch without either (a) sweeping your uncommitted cg6.3 into my commit, or (b) leaving a non-compiling HEAD.

Please commit cg6.3 now (it's green + lint-clean) — I'll land my batch immediately after and close is1.6 + l4s.3. If you'd rather I commit everything together, say so and I'll attribute your cg6.3 work in the message.
